entities.summary: Kevin Buckler is an American race car driver and entrepreneur. He founded Adobe Road Winery and currently owns The Racer's Group, a professional sports car racing team; TRG Motorsports, formerly a NASCAR Sprint Cup Series team; and TRG-Aston Martin Racing. In 2019, Buckler launched a $56 racing-themed wine named SHIFT through his winery Adobe Road.
